settings.name: The Drowned Kingdom
settings.desc: A kingdom that went under with its oaths still on. Wet stone, dark water, broken crowns.
settings.intro: Book One. The Drowned Kingdom. Mind the water; it remembers who was standing in it.

settings.name: The Flesh Cathedral
settings.desc: A church that kept growing after the congregation stopped. Bone ribs, warm floors, terrible hymns.
settings.intro: Book Two. The Flesh Cathedral. Everything in here heals. That is the problem.

settings.name: The Iron Frontier
settings.desc: A frontier of failed machines. Rust, rails, steam and things that still clock in.
settings.intro: Book Three. The Iron Frontier. The machines still keep shifts. You are not on the rota.

settings.name: The End of the Table
settings.desc: Where the campaign runs out of world and the table starts showing through.
settings.intro: Book Four. The End of the Table. I did not finish painting this part. You will forgive me.
